headline: Sonaselection India declares June quarter financial results
hook: June quarter results now on record
summary: Sonaselection India Limited has formally submitted its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. These routine filings provide the latest operational and financial data for the company's performance during the period. Retail shareholders can review the reported earnings to assess the firm's financial health and quarterly trajectory.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data updates your holding's fundamentals.
